how_to_apply: Apply only online on the website https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in.
The online application opens at 11:00 AM on 30 November 2026 and closes at 11:00 PM on 14 December 2026.
Study the information and instructions related to the recruitment, then fill in the online application form.
For more information, contact the Recruitment department on 0261-2423751-56, Ext-231/299.
Candidates must fulfil the qualifications and conditions under the recruitment rules and examination rules of the concerned post.
important_instructions: The vacancies are department-wise; the notice lists each department's posts separately. The recruitment is for making a waiting list against regular vacancies. Qualification is judged under the NMC rules prevailing on the date of the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 23 vacancies: 2 Associate Professor posts and 21 Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 14 December 2026, up to 11:00 PM. Applications open at 11:00 AM on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for the SMC Associate and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Apply online on https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in within the window from 30 November 2026 to 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor in General Medicine at SMC?
faq.answer: The qualification is M.D. in General Medicine or DNB in General Medicine, as notified by the NMC on 30 June 2025.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the Assistant Professor (Dentistry) post?
faq.answer: The notice lists M.D.S for the Dentistry post. There is 1 vacancy.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of an Associate Professor at SMC?
faq.answer: The Associate Professor pay matrix is Rs. 1,31,400-2,17,100, with Academic Grade Pay of 9000/- and Pay Band 37,400-67,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of an Assistant Professor at SMC?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor pay matrix is Rs. 68,900-2,05,500, with Academic Grade Pay of 7000/- and Pay Band 15,600-39,100/-.

faq.question: Q8. Which department has the most Assistant Professor vacancies?
faq.answer: General Surgery has the most, with 6 posts, followed by General Medicine with 5.

faq.question: Q9. Are these regular posts?
faq.answer: The notice calls them regular vacancies filled through direct recruitment, for the purpose of making a waiting list.

faq.question: Q10. Whom can I contact for more information?
faq.answer: Call the Recruitment department of Surat Municipal Corporation on 0261-2423751-56, Ext-231/299.
